ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

text.en: PMJJBY is a one-year life insurance scheme, renewable every year.

description.quote: The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a one-year life insurance Scheme renewable from year to year.

text.en: Life cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason.

benefits.quote: It offers coverage of Rs. Two lacs for death due to any reason and is available to people in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a bank account.

text.en: Annual premium ₹436; cover period 1 June to 31 May.
